messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am trying out RSWAT for ET calibration. I have to calibrate for 38 subbains but for simplicity, I am trying out with only 1 subbasin. I am using output.sub to extract SWAT ET data.

messages.body_plain:
thanks for using R-SWAT.
I have tested with my example data (https://github.com/tamnva/R-SWAT/tree/master/data/TxtInOut), in which I calibrated for ET at from subbasin Nr. 3 (see attached figure 1-4) and I assumed the observed ET is as attached (obs_var_1.txt), there is not problem
Note: In your case, multiple basin, in figure 3 => Table 1 => column Reach should be 1,2,3,.... as many subbasins as you want, separated by comma, and the corresponding observed data file names should be obs_var_1.txt, obs_var_2.txt, obs_var_3.txt,...

messages.subject: R-SWAT publication
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I would like to share with you the first publication of R-SWAT in Environmental Modelling and Software. R-SWAT now can be cited as follows:

Nguyen, T. V., Dietrich, J., Dang, D. T., Tran, D. A., Doan, B. V., Sarrazin, F. J., Abbaspour, K., Srinivasan, R. (2022). An interactive graphical interface tool for parameter calibration, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty analysis, and visualization for the Soil and Water Assessment Tool. Environmental Modelling & Software, 105497. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envsoft.2022.105497

Below is the URL for 50 days' free access (until October 09, 2022)

https://authors.elsevier.com/a/1fcbW4sKhEVT5M

Cheers,
Tam

messages.subject: R-SWAT is now available for SWAT+
messages.subject_clean: R-SWAT is now available for SWAT+
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

R-SWAT is now available for SWAT+ in the same interface. This version is under development - there are some basic functions that users can use for SWAT+

Now it is in the development branch as shown in the link below (will be merge to the master branch later)

https://github.com/tamnva/R-SWAT/tree/development_SWATplus

Cheers,
Tam
